/* SECTION: CSS VARIABLES */
:root {
  --cy-cyan: #00f0ff;
  --cy-magenta: #ff2d95;
  --cy-purple: #b429f9;
  --cy-lime: #7bff00;
  --cy-bg: #06060f;
  --cy-bg-2: #0a0a18;
  --cy-surface: rgba(14, 14, 31, 0.72);
  --cy-surface-2: rgba(20, 20, 42, 0.85);
  --cy-border: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.14);
  --cy-border-hi: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.45);
  --cy-text: #e8e8f0;
  --cy-muted: #8b8ba8;
  --cy-glow-cyan: 0 0 24px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.45), 0 0 48px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.18);
  --cy-glow-magenta: 0 0 24px rgba(255, 45, 149, 0.5), 0 0 48px rgba(255, 45, 149, 0.2);
  --grad-main: linear-gradient(135deg, #00f0ff 0%, #b429f9 50%, #ff2d95 100%);
  --grad-soft: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,240,255,.15) 0%, rgba(180,41,249,.15) 50%, rgba(255,45,149,.15) 100%);
}

/* SECTION: BASE RESET */
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: #00f0ff #0a0a18; }
body {
  background: #06060f !important;
  color: #e8e8f0 !important;
  font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif;
  margin: 0; line-height: 1.65; font-size: 16px;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  position: relative;
  min-height: 100vh;
}
a { color: var(--cy-cyan); text-decoration: none; transition: color .25s ease; }
a:hover { color: var(--cy-magenta); }
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #0a0a18; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #00f0ff, #b429f9); border-radius: 10px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff2d95, #00f0ff); }
::selection { background: rgba(0,240,255,0.28); color: #fff; }

/* SECTION: BACKGROUND LAYERS */
.bg-layer { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: -1; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, rgba(0,240,255,0.14) 0%, transparent 45%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 85% 60%, rgba(255,45,149,0.12) 0%, transparent 45%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 100%, rgba(180,41,249,0.1) 0%, transparent 45%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at top, #0d0d24 0%, #06060f 55%);
}
.bg-orb { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0.9; }
.bg-orb-1 { width: 620px; height: 620px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0,240,255,0.28) 0%, rgba(0,240,255,0.08) 35%, transparent 70%); top: -180px; left: -180px; animation: floatOrb1 22s ease-in-out infinite; }
.bg-orb-2 { width: 580px; height: 580px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,45,149,0.24) 0%, rgba(255,45,149,0.07) 35%, transparent 70%); top: 40%; right: -200px; animation: floatOrb2 26s ease-in-out infinite; }
.bg-orb-3 { width: 520px; height: 520px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(180,41,249,0.22) 0%, rgba(180,41,249,0.06) 35%, transparent 70%); bottom: -200px; left: 30%; animation: floatOrb3 30s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes floatOrb1 { 0%,100% { transform: translate(0,0) scale(1); } 50% { transform: translate(80px, 100px) scale(1.15); } }
@keyframes floatOrb2 { 0%,100% { transform: translate(0,0) scale(1); } 50% { transform: translate(-100px, -80px) scale(1.2); } }
@keyframes floatOrb3 { 0%,100% { transform: translate(0,0) scale(1); } 50% { transform: translate(120px, -60px) scale(1.1); } }
.bg-grid { position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at center, transparent 0%, transparent 25%, rgba(6,6,15,0.55) 60%, rgba(6,6,15,0.98) 100%),
    linear-gradient(rgba(0,240,255,0.055) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,240,255,0.055) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 100% 100%, 56px 56px, 56px 56px;
}
.bg-scan { position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,240,255,0.02) 0px, rgba(0,240,255,0.02) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 3px);
  opacity: 0.5; animation: scanMove 8s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes scanMove { 0% { background-position: 0 0; } 100% { background-position: 0 100px; } }

/* SECTION: LAYOUT CONTAINER */
.container { max-width: 1320px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 18px; position: relative; z-index: 1; }

/* SECTION: SITE HEADER */
.site-header {
  background: rgba(6, 6, 15, 0.96) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,240,255,0.12) !important;
  position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1000;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
}
.site-header::after {
  content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #00f0ff, #b429f9, #ff2d95, transparent);
  opacity: 0.7;
}
.header-container { max-width: 1320px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 16px 18px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }
.header-widget { flex: 0 0 auto; text-align: left; margin-right: 15px; }
.header-widget .logo-title {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00f0ff 0%, #b429f9 50%, #ff2d95 100%) !important;
  background-size: 200% 200% !important;
  -webkit-background-clip: text !important;
  background-clip: text !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent !important;
  text-decoration: none;
  animation: gradientShift 6s ease infinite;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,240,255,0.3);
}
@keyframes gradientShift { 0%, 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; } 50% { background-position: 100% 50%; } }
.header-widget .logo-img img { max-height: 45px; width: auto; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(0,240,255,.5)); }
.header-widget .description { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--cy-muted) !important; margin-top: 4px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; }

/* SECTION: HAMBURGER & MOBILE BUTTONS */
.hamburger, .search-mobile-btn, .mobile-menu-header button {
  display: none;
  background: rgba(0,240,255,0.06) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--cy-border) !important;
  border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer;
  width: 42px; height: 42px;
  align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  position: relative; z-index: 1001;
  transition: all .3s ease;
  color: var(--cy-cyan) !important;
  font-size: 1.15rem; padding: 0; line-height: 1;
}
.hamburger:hover, .search-mobile-btn:hover, .mobile-menu-header button:hover {
  background: rgba(0,240,255,0.15) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  border-color: var(--cy-cyan) !important;
  box-shadow: var(--cy-glow-cyan);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}
.hamburger i, .search-mobile-btn i { pointer-events: none; display: block; }

/* SECTION: DESKTOP SEARCH */
.search-desktop {
  display: flex; align-items: center;
  background: rgba(0,240,255,0.05) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--cy-border) !important;
  border-radius: 30px; padding: 4px 6px 4px 16px;
  transition: border-color .3s, box-shadow .3s;
  margin-left: auto;
}
.search-desktop:focus-within { border-color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,240,255,.12), var(--cy-glow-cyan); }
.search-desktop form { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; margin: 0; }
.search-desktop input { border: none; background: transparent; outline: none; font-size: 0.88rem; width: 170px; color: var(--cy-text) !important; font-family: inherit; }
.search-desktop input::placeholder { color: var(--cy-muted) !important; }
.search-desktop button { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00f0ff 0%, #b429f9 100%) !important; border: none; cursor: pointer; color: #06060f; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: transform .3s, box-shadow .3s; font-weight: 700; }
.search-desktop button:hover { transform: scale(1.1); box-shadow: var(--cy-glow-cyan); }

/* SECTION: SOCIAL ICONS */
.social-desktop { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
#header-networks-wrapper .widget { background: transparent !important; border: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; padding: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important; }
.social-networks { display: flex; gap: 10px; }
.social-networks a { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; display: flex !important; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 1.05rem; color: #fff !important; transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), box-shadow .35s; border: 1px solid var(--cy-border); position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.social-networks a::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.2)); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .3s; }
.social-networks a:hover { transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.05); }
.social-networks a:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
.social-networks a i { pointer-events: none; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.social-networks a.net-whatsapp { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #25D366, #128C7E); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(37,211,102,.3); }
.social-networks a.net-telegram { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00b4ff, #0088cc); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,136,204,.3); }
.social-networks a.net-youtube { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff2d2d, #b30000); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255,45,45,.3); }
.social-networks a.net-other { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7b2fff, #4b1a9c); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(123,47,255,.3); }
.social-icon.whatsapp { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #25D366, #128C7E); }
.social-icon.telegram { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00b4ff, #0088cc); }
.social-icon.youtube { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff2d2d, #b30000); }

/* SECTION: TICKER */
.ticker-wrapper { width: 100%; height: 30px; background: #0a0a18 !important; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--cy-border) !important; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: center; position: relative; z-index: 999; }
.ticker-wrapper::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #00f0ff, #ff2d95, transparent); opacity: 0.5; }
.ticker-label { flex-shrink: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00f0ff 0%, #b429f9 100%) !important; color: #06060f !important; font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif; font-size: 0.6rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0 12px; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; letter-spacing: 2px; margin-right: 1rem; box-shadow: 4px 0 30px rgba(0,240,255,0.5); position: relative; }
.ticker-label::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: -8px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 0; height: 0; border-top: 15px solid transparent; border-bottom: 15px solid transparent; border-left: 8px solid #b429f9; }
.ticker-track { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; position: relative; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; }
.ticker-content { display: flex; align-items: center; white-space: nowrap; animation: ticker-scroll 55s linear infinite; width: max-content; }
.ticker-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; margin-right: 2.2rem; color: #c5c5d8 !important; font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 500; transition: color 0.25s; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }
.ticker-item::before { content: '\25B8'; color: var(--cy-cyan); font-size: 0.82rem; text-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--cy-cyan); }
.ticker-item:hover { color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; }
.ticker-item img { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 6px; object-fit: cover; object-position: top; flex-shrink: 0; border: 1px solid var(--cy-border); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0,240,255,0.25); }
@keyframes ticker-scroll { 0% { transform: translateX(0); } 100% { transform: translateX(-50%); } }
.ticker-track:hover .ticker-content { animation-play-state: paused; }

/* SECTION: WHATSAPP FLOAT */
.whatsapp-float { position: fixed; bottom: 24px; left: 24px; z-index: 999; width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #25D366, #128C7E); color: #fff !important; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 1.4rem; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(37,211,102,.55); transition: all .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); text-decoration: none !important; }
.whatsapp-float:hover { transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1.08); color: #fff !important; box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(37,211,102,.7); }
.whatsapp-float i { pointer-events: none; }
.whatsapp-tooltip { position: fixed; bottom: 34px; left: 86px; background: rgba(14,14,31,0.98); color: #fff; padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transform: translateX(-10px); transition: opacity .4s ease, visibility .4s ease, transform .4s ease; z-index: 998; border: 1px solid var(--cy-border-hi); box-shadow: var(--cy-glow-cyan); }
.whatsapp-tooltip::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -6px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); border: 6px solid transparent; border-right-color: var(--cy-cyan); }
.whatsapp-tooltip.show { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translateX(0); }

/* SECTION: BACK TO TOP */
#back-to-top { position: fixed; bottom: 24px; right: 24px; z-index: 999; width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00f0ff 0%, #b429f9 100%) !important; color: #06060f !important; border: none; font-size: 1.1rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transition: opacity .35s, visibility .35s, transform .35s; transform: translateY(20px); box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,240,255,.5); padding: 0; }
#back-to-top.show { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translateY(0); }
#back-to-top:hover { transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1.08); box-shadow: 0 14px 44px rgba(0,240,255,.7); }
#back-to-top i { position: relative; z-index: 2; pointer-events: none; }
.progress-ring { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; transform: rotate(-90deg); pointer-events: none; z-index: 1; }
.progress-ring__circle { stroke-dasharray: 144.51; stroke-dashoffset: 144.51; stroke-linecap: round; transition: stroke-dashoffset 0.1s linear; }

/* SECTION: DESKTOP NAV */
.desktop-nav { margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; display: none; flex: 1; }
.desktop-nav .main-nav { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 4px; background: transparent !important; border: none !important; border-radius: 0; }
.desktop-nav .main-nav li { position: relative; }
.desktop-nav .main-nav > li > a { color: var(--cy-muted) !important; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; transition: background .3s, color .3s; white-space: nowrap; position: relative; background: transparent !important; box-shadow: none !important; }
.desktop-nav .main-nav > li > a i { color: var(--cy-muted) !important; transition: color .3s; }
.desktop-nav .main-nav > li > a:hover { background: rgba(0,240,255,0.08) !important; color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; }
.desktop-nav .main-nav > li > a:hover i { color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; }
.desktop-nav .main-nav li.has-children > a::after { content: '\f078'; font-family: 'Font Awesome 6 Free'; font-weight: 900; font-size: 0.55rem; margin-left: 2px; color: var(--cy-muted); transition: transform .3s; }
.desktop-nav .main-nav li.has-children:hover > a::after { transform: rotate(180deg); color: var(--cy-cyan); }
.desktop-nav .main-nav ul { position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0; background: #0e0e1f; border: 1px solid var(--cy-border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px; display: none; flex-direction: column; min-width: 220px; z-index: 100; box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0 0 30px rgba(0,240,255,.15); gap: 2px; margin: 0; list-style: none; }
.desktop-nav .main-nav ul::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -10px; left: 0; right: 0; height: 10px; }
.desktop-nav .main-nav li:hover > ul { display: flex; animation: menuIn .3s ease; }
@keyframes menuIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
.desktop-nav .main-nav ul li { width: 100%; }
.desktop-nav .main-nav ul li > a { padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 0.85rem; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--cy-text) !important; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; transition: background .25s, color .25s; }
.desktop-nav .main-nav ul li > a i { color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; }
.desktop-nav .main-nav ul li > a:hover { background: rgba(0,240,255,0.1) !important; color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; }
.desktop-nav .main-nav ul li.has-children > a::after { content: '\f054'; font-size: 0.55rem; color: var(--cy-cyan); margin-left: auto; }
.desktop-nav .main-nav ul ul { top: 0; left: 100%; margin-left: 6px; min-width: 200px; }

/* SECTION: MOBILE MENU */
.mobile-menu { position: fixed; top: 0; left: -100%; width: 320px; max-width: 88%; height: 100%; background: #080814 !important; border-right: 1px solid var(--cy-border) !important; box-shadow: 8px 0 60px rgba(0,240,255,0.15); z-index: 1001; transition: left 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 22px 18px; overflow-y: auto; }
.mobile-menu.open { left: 0; }
.mobile-menu-header { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.mobile-menu nav > ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 20px; }
.mobile-menu nav ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
.mobile-menu nav > ul > li { margin-bottom: 4px; }
.mobile-menu nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: var(--cy-text) !important; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 10px; transition: background .3s, color .3s, border .3s; border-left: 3px solid transparent; text-decoration: none !important; }
.mobile-menu nav > ul > li > a:hover, .mobile-menu nav > ul > li.open > a { background: rgba(0,240,255,0.08) !important; color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; border-left-color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(0,240,255,.08); }
.mobile-menu nav a i { font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--cy-cyan); flex-shrink: 0; width: 18px; text-align: center; }
.mobile-menu nav li.has-children > a::after { content: '\f078'; font-family: 'Font Awesome 6 Free'; font-weight: 900; font-size: 0.65rem; margin-left: auto; color: var(--cy-cyan); transition: transform .3s; flex-shrink: 0; }
.mobile-menu nav li.has-children.open > a::after { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.mobile-menu nav li.has-children > ul { display: none; padding-left: 18px; margin-top: 4px; margin-bottom: 6px; border-left: 2px solid rgba(0,240,255,0.2); }
.mobile-menu nav li.has-children.open > ul { display: block; animation: menuIn .3s ease; }
.mobile-menu nav li > ul > li > a { font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 10px 12px; font-weight: 500; }
.mobile-menu nav li > ul > li > ul > li > a { font-size: 0.84rem; padding: 8px 12px; color: var(--cy-muted) !important; }
.mobile-social { margin-top: auto; display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; padding-top: 22px; border-top: 1px solid var(--cy-border) !important; }
.mobile-social .social-icon { width: 46px; height: 46px; font-size: 1.2rem; }
.social-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fff !important; transition: transform .3s, box-shadow .3s; border-radius: 12px; }
.social-icon:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); }

/* SECTION: OVERLAYS */
.overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.82); opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transition: opacity 0.35s, visibility 0.35s; z-index: 1000; }
.overlay.show { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }
.search-overlay { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; background: #080814 !important; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--cy-border) !important; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 8px 60px rgba(0,240,255,0.2); transform: translateY(-100%); transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); z-index: 1001; }
.search-overlay.open { transform: translateY(0); }
.search-overlay form { display: flex; gap: 10px; }
.search-overlay input { flex: 1; padding: 13px 18px; background: rgba(0,240,255,0.05) !important; border: 1px solid var(--cy-border) !important; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--cy-text) !important; font-family: inherit; outline: none; }
.search-overlay input:focus { border-color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,240,255,.12); }
.search-overlay button { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00f0ff 0%, #b429f9 100%) !important; color: #06060f; border: none; padding: 13px 24px; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; font-family: inherit; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
.search-close { background: rgba(0,240,255,0.05) !important; border: 1px solid var(--cy-border) !important; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; font-size: 1.1rem; cursor: pointer; width: 44px; height: 44px; margin-bottom: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: all .3s; }
.search-close:hover { background: rgba(0,240,255,0.15) !important; color: #fff !important; border-color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; box-shadow: var(--cy-glow-cyan); transform: scale(1.05); }

/* SECTION: HERO SEARCH */
.hero-search-section { max-width: 1320px; margin: 40px auto 26px; padding: 0 18px; text-align: center; position: relative; }
.hero-text-container { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto 30px; text-align: center; }

.error-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 8px; }
.error-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 11px 22px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(0,240,255,0.06); border: 1px solid var(--cy-border); color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: inherit; text-decoration: none !important; transition: all 0.3s; }
.error-btn:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00f0ff 0%, #b429f9 100%); color: #06060f !important; border-color: transparent; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,240,255,.4); }
@media (max-width: 480px) { .error-page { padding: 40px 18px; } .error-search { flex-direction: column; border-radius: 20px; } .error-search button { border-radius: 14px; justify-content: center; } .error-btn { flex: 1 1 45%; justify-content: center; } }

/* SECTION: COMMENTS */
.comments { margin-top: 32px; }
.comments h4.title { font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif; font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 22px; color: var(--cy-text) !important; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; letter-spacing: 1.2px; text-transform: uppercase; }
.comments h4.title::before { content: ''; width: 4px; height: 20px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #00f0ff 0%, #ff2d95 100%); border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0,240,255,.7); }
.comment { display: flex; gap: 1rem; padding: 16px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--cy-border) !important; }
.comment-avatar { width: 50px; height: 50px; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden; flex-shrink: 0; border: 2px solid rgba(0,240,255,.35) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(0,240,255,.25); }
.comment-avatar img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.comment-block { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.comment-header { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
.comment-author { font-weight: 600; color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; font-size: 0.9rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }
.comment-time { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--cy-muted) !important; }
.comment-content { font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.65; color: #cfcfdd !important; }
.comment-content a { color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; }
.comment-footer { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; margin-top: 0.6rem; }
.comment-reply-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--cy-border) !important; padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 20px; font-family: inherit; transition: all .25s; }
.comment-reply-button:hover { background: rgba(0,240,255,0.08) !important; border-color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0,240,255,.3); }
.comment-replies-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--cy-magenta) !important; cursor: pointer; transition: color .25s; }
.comment-replies-label:hover { color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; }
.comment-replies-label i { font-size: 0.9rem; }
.comment-toggle { display: none; }
.comment-toggle:not(:checked) ~ .comments-replies { display: none; }
.comments-replies { margin-top: 1rem; padding-left: 1.5rem; border-left: 2px solid rgba(0,240,255,.2); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; }
.comment-toggle-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 16px 24px; background: rgba(14,14,31,0.92) !important; border: 1px solid var(--cy-border) !important; border-radius: 14px; color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: all .3s; margin-top: 1.5rem; }
.comment-toggle-btn:hover { background: rgba(0,240,255,0.08) !important; border-color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(0,240,255,.3); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.comment-form-wrapper { display: none; margin-top: 1.5rem; }
.comment-form-wrapper.show { display: block; animation: cardReveal .4s ease forwards; }
.comment-form { padding: 24px; background: rgba(20,20,42,0.92) !important; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--cy-border) !important; }
#comment-editor { width: 100% !important; min-height: 200px; background: #0e0e1f !important; border: 1px solid var(--cy-border) !important; border-radius: 12px; }
.reply-notice { display: none; margin-bottom: 1rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.1rem; background: rgba(0,240,255,0.08) !important; border-left: 4px solid var(--cy-cyan) !important; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; font-size: 0.88rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.reply-notice.show { display: flex; }
.cancel-reply-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.4rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 50px; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12) !important; border: 1px solid #ef4444 !important; color: #ff6b6b !important; cursor: pointer; transition: all .25s; margin-left: auto; font-family: inherit; }
.cancel-reply-btn:hover { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25) !important; }

/* SECTION: COOKIE BANNER & MODALS */
.cookie-banner { position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; background: #080814 !important; border-top: 1px solid var(--cy-border-hi) !important; z-index: 10000; padding: 1.1rem 1.5rem; display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; box-shadow: 0 -10px 60px rgba(0,240,255,.15); }
.cookie-banner__text { flex: 1 1 280px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #cfcfdd !important; line-height: 1.55; text-align: center; }
.cookie-banner__text a { color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: underline; }
.cookie-banner__actions { display: flex; gap: 0.8rem; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; }
.cookie-banner__btn { padding: 0.6rem 1.8rem; border-radius: 40px; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: all .3s; font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 1px; white-space: nowrap; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; }
.cookie-banner__btn--accept { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00f0ff 0%, #b429f9 100%) !important; color: #06060f !important; box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0,240,255,.4); }
.cookie-banner__btn--accept:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 34px rgba(0,240,255,.6); }
.cookie-banner__btn--reject { background: transparent !important; color: var(--cy-muted) !important; border: 1px solid var(--cy-border) !important; }
.cookie-banner__btn--reject:hover { background: rgba(0,240,255,0.05) !important; color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; border-color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; }

.blocker-modal { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(6, 6, 15, 0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px); z-index: 99999; display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 24px; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transition: opacity .3s ease, visibility .3s ease; }
.blocker-modal.show { display: flex; opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }
.blocker-modal__box { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #14142a 0%, #0e0e1f 100%); border: 1px solid var(--cy-border-hi); border-radius: 20px; padding: 36px 32px 28px; max-width: 460px; width: 100%; text-align: center; position: relative; box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.7), 0 0 60px rgba(0,240,255,.2); animation: modalIn .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); }
.blocker-modal__box::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 20%; right: 20%; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #00f0ff, #ff2d95, transparent); border-radius: 2px; }
@keyframes modalIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px) scale(.94); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } }
.blocker-modal__icon { width: 72px; height: 72px; margin: 0 auto 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,240,255,.15), rgba(255,45,149,.15)); border: 1px solid var(--cy-border-hi); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 1.7rem; color: var(--cy-cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0,240,255,.3), inset 0 0 24px rgba(0,240,255,.15); }
.blocker-modal__title { font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--cy-text); margin: 0 0 16px; letter-spacing: .5px; line-height: 1.3; }
.blocker-modal__text { color: #cfcfdd; font-size: .92rem; line-height: 1.65; margin: 0 0 14px; }
.blocker-modal__text strong { color: var(--cy-cyan); font-weight: 700; }
.blocker-modal__actions { margin-top: 22px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.blocker-modal__actions .cookie-banner__btn { 
  padding: 14px 20px; 
  font-size: .85rem; 
  display: flex; 
  flex-direction: row; 
  flex-wrap: wrap; 
  align-items: center; 
  justify-content: center; 
  text-align: center; 
  white-space: normal; 
  line-height: 1.4; 
  height: auto; 
  min-height: 48px; 
  word-break: break-word; 
}
.blocker-modal__actions .cookie-banner__btn i { margin-right: 6px; }
.blocker-modal__hint { font-size: .76rem; color: var(--cy-muted); margin: 18px 0 0; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px dashed rgba(0,240,255,.15); }
.blocker-modal__hint a { color: var(--cy-cyan); text-decoration: underline; font-weight: 700; }

/* SECTION: FOOTER */
footer { background: rgba(8,8,20,0.96) !important; border-top: 1px solid var(--cy-border) !important; color: var(--cy-text) !important; padding: 40px 0 28px; margin-top: 60px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
footer::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #00f0ff, #b429f9, #ff2d95, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,240,255,.5); }
footer::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 200px; height: 100px; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at top, rgba(0,240,255,.15), transparent 70%); pointer-events: none; }
.footer-content { max-width: 1320px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 18px; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.legal-links { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 22px 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 24px; }
.legal-links a { color: var(--cy-muted) !important; font-size: 0.85rem; transition: color .25s; position: relative; }
.legal-links a:hover { color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; }
.legal-links a::before { content: '\25C6'; color: var(--cy-magenta); margin-right: 6px; font-size: 0.55rem; vertical-align: middle; }
.copyright { text-align: center; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--cy-muted) !important; margin-top: 14px; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--cy-border) !important; }
.copyright p { margin: 0; line-height: 1.7; }
.copyright p:first-child { color: var(--cy-text) !important; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 1px; }

/* SECTION: SIDEBAR LISTS */
.sidebar .widget-content ul, .sidebar .widget-content .list-label-widget-content ul { list-style: none !important; padding: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important; display: flex !important; flex-wrap: wrap !important; gap: 8px !important; }
.sidebar .widget-content ul li { margin: 0 !important; }
.sidebar .widget-content ul li a, .sidebar .label-cloud a { display: inline-block !important; background: rgba(0,240,255,0.06) !important; color: var(--cy-cyan) !important; padding: 7px 16px !important; border-radius: 20px !important; font-size: 0.8rem !important; font-weight: 600 !important; border: 1px solid rgba(0,240,255,0.2) !important; transition: all 0.3s ease !important; text-decoration: none !important; line-height: 1.4 !important; }
.sidebar .widget-content ul li a:hover, .sidebar .label-cloud a:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00f0ff, #b429f9) !important; color: #06060f !important; border-color: transparent !important; transform: translateY(-2px) !important; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,240,255,.4) !important; }

/* SECTION: RESPONSIVE - MOBILE */
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .hamburger { display: flex; }
  .search-mobile-btn { display: flex; }
  .search-desktop, .social-desktop, .desktop-nav { display: none !important; }
  .header-widget { text-align: center; flex: 1; margin-right: 0; }
  .header-widget .logo-title { font-size: 1.15rem; letter-spacing: 1.5px; }
  .ad-desktop { display: none !important; }
  .ad-mobile { display: block !important; }
  body { font-size: 14px; }
  .container { padding: 0 14px; }
  .hero-search-section { padding: 0 14px; margin: 24px auto 20px; }
  .hero-main-title { font-size: 1.05rem; }
  .hero-search-box { flex-direction: column; padding: 14px; border-radius: 22px; gap: 10px; align-items: stretch; }
  .hsf-field { padding: 0 16px; background: rgba(0,240,255,0.04); border: 1px solid var(--cy-border); border-radius: 14px; transition: border-color 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; gap: 12px; }
  .hsf-field:focus-within { border-color: var(--cy-cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,240,255,.1); background: rgba(0,240,255,0.06); }
  .hsf-category { border-right: none; padding-right: 16px; position: relative; }
  .hsf-category select { width: 100%; padding: 15px 26px 15px 0; font-size: 0.92rem; min-width: 0; text-align: left; }
  .hsf-arrow { right: 18px; }
  .hsf-input { padding-left: 16px; padding-right: 16px; }
  .hsf-input input { padding: 15px 0; font-size: 0.92rem; text-align: left; }
  .hero-search-box button[type='submit'] { width: 100%; border-radius: 14px; padding: 15px; justify-content: center; font-size: 0.85rem; }
  .posts-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 10px; }
  .psp-card-content { padding: 10px 10px 9px; }
  .psp-card-title { font-size: 0.78rem; margin-bottom: 6px; height: 2.4em; }
  .psp-stats span { font-size: 0.62rem; }
  .psp-tags { top: 8px; left: 8px; gap: 4px; max-width: calc(100% - 16px); }
  .tag-psp, .tag-cat { font-size: 0.52rem; padding: 2px 7px; }
  .header-container { padding: 10px 14px; gap: 8px; }
  .post { padding: 20px; }
  .share-buttons { display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap; gap: 6px; }
  .share-btn { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; padding: 9px 6px; font-size: 0.66rem; gap: 5px; justify-content: center; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 10px; }
  .mobile-menu-header button { display: flex; }
  .ticker-wrapper { height: 28px; }
  .ticker-label { font-size: 0.54rem; padding: 0 10px; }
  .ticker-label::after { border-top-width: 14px; border-bottom-width: 14px; }
  .ticker-item { font-size: 0.66rem; margin-right: 1.1rem; gap: 0.4rem; }
  .ticker-item img { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
  .whatsapp-float { width: 46px; height: 46px; font-size: 1.2rem; bottom: 16px; left: 16px; }
  .whatsapp-tooltip { bottom: 28px; left: 72px; font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 6px 10px; }
  #back-to-top { bottom: 16px; right: 16px; width: 46px; height: 46px; font-size: 0.95rem; }
  .progress-ring { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
  .progress-ring__circle { r: 20; }
  .bg-grid { background-size: 100% 100%, 40px 40px, 40px 40px; }
  .related-carousel { gap: 12px; padding-bottom: 12px; }
  .related-carousel .psp-card { flex: 0 0 160px; }
  .related-carousel .psp-card-content { padding: 8px 10px 10px; }
  .related-carousel .psp-card-title { font-size: 0.76rem; margin-bottom: 6px; height: 2.4em; }
  .related-carousel .psp-stats span { font-size: 0.6rem; }
  .rel-btn { width: 36px; height: 36px; font-size: 0.82rem; border-radius: 10px; }
  .blocker-modal__box { padding: 24px 18px; }
  .blocker-modal__title { font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .blocker-modal__text { font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.5; }
  .blocker-modal__icon { width: 60px; height: 60px; font-size: 1.4rem; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .blocker-modal__actions .cookie-banner__btn { font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 12px 16px; }
}

/* SECTION: RESPONSIVE - TABLET */
@media (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 767px) {
  .ticker-wrapper { height: 36px; }
  .ticker-label { font-size: 0.6rem; padding: 0 12px; margin-right: 0.8rem; }
  .ticker-label::after { border-top-width: 18px; border-bottom-width: 18px; }
  .ticker-item { font-size: 0.74rem; margin-right: 1.6rem; gap: 0.5rem; }
  .ticker-item img { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
}

@media (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 1023px) {
  .hamburger { display: flex !important; }
  .search-mobile-btn { display: none !important; }
  .search-desktop { display: flex !important; }
  .social-desktop, .desktop-nav { display: none !important; }
  .header-container { padding: 22px 18px; }
  .header-widget { text-align: center; flex: 1; margin-right: 0; }
  .ticker-wrapper { height: 34px; }
  .ticker-label { font-size: 0.62rem; padding: 0 13px; margin-right: 1rem; }
  .ticker-label::after { border-top-width: 17px; border-bottom-width: 17px; }
  .ticker-item { font-size: 0.76rem; margin-right: 2.2rem; }
  .ticker-item img { width: 21px; height: 21px; }
  .ad-desktop { display: none !important; }
  .ad-mobile { display: block !important; }
  .posts-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
  .sidebar .posts-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
  .mobile-menu-header button { display: flex; }
  .related-carousel .psp-card { flex: 0 0 200px; }
  .related-loader { flex: 0 0 200px; }
}

/* SECTION: RESPONSIVE - TABLET LANDSCAPE */
@media (min-width: 900px) and (max-width: 1366px) and (orientation: landscape) and (pointer: coarse) {
  .hamburger, .mobile-menu-header button { display: none !important; }
  .search-mobile-btn { display: flex !important; }
  .search-desktop { display: none !important; }
  .social-desktop { display: flex !important; }
  .desktop-nav { display: block !important; }
  .desktop-nav .main-nav { display: flex !important; }
  .header-container { padding: 14px 16px; gap: 6px; }
  .header-widget { text-align: left !important; flex: 0 0 auto !important; margin-right: 8px !important; }
  .header-widget .logo-title { font-size: 1.05rem !important; letter-spacing: 1.2px !important; }
  .header-widget .description { display: none !important; }
  .desktop-nav .main-nav > li > a { padding: 7px 9px !important; font-size: 0.78rem !important; gap: 6px !important; }
  .desktop-nav .main-nav > li > a i { font-size: 0.78rem !important; }
  .social-desktop { order: 2; gap: 6px !important; margin-left: 0 !important; }
  .social-networks { gap: 6px !important; }
  .social-networks a { width: 36px !important; height: 36px !important; font-size: 0.95rem !important; border-radius: 10px !important; padding: 0 !important; }
  .social-networks a i { font-size: 0.95rem !important; }
  .search-mobile-btn { order: 1; margin-left: auto !important; width: 36px !important; height: 36px !important; font-size: 0.95rem !important; border-radius: 10px !important; padding: 0 !important; }
}

/* SECTION: RESPONSIVE - DESKTOP */
@media (min-width: 1024px) and (pointer: fine) {
  .hamburger, .search-mobile-btn, .mobile-menu-header button { display: none !important; }
  .search-desktop, .social-desktop { display: flex; }
  .desktop-nav { display: block; }
  .desktop-nav .main-nav { display: flex; }
  .sidebar { flex: 0 0 340px; }
  .content { flex: 1; }
  .ad-desktop { display: block !important; }
  .ad-mobile { display: none !important; }
  .posts-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); }
  .sidebar .posts-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .header-container { padding: 16px 18px; }
  .header-widget { text-align: left; flex: 0 0 auto; margin-right: 15px; }
}

@media (orientation: landscape) and (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 1023px) {
  .sidebar .posts-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
}

@media (min-width: 1200px) { .posts-grid { gap: 20px; } }

/* SECTION: REDUCED MOTION */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; }
  .ticker-content { animation: none; }
  .psp-card { opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; }
}
